payoff_structure.Iran_government: Seek sanctions relief via negotiation while maintaining domestic legitimacy; payoff: economic stabilization vs political cost of concessions
payoff_structure.IRGC: Prefer resistance economy; payoff: institutional power vs economic collapse risk
payoff_structure.US_admin: Maximize pressure for nuclear/regional concessions; payoff: leverage vs oil price spike/global inflation
payoff_structure.Supreme_Leader: Balance regime survival with economic pressure; payoff: controlled adaptation vs systemic risk
payoff_structure.China: Secure discounted oil; payoff: energy security vs secondary sanctions risk
payoff_structure.Global_commodity_markets: Price in supply disruption risk; payoff: volatility premium vs demand destruction

game_theory.equilibrium: Unstable mixed strategy: Iran signals negotiation readiness (Pezeshkian) while IRGC threatens Hormuz; US escalates sanctions but avoids kinetic action. Nash equilibrium not reached - dynamic game with incomplete information.
signaling: Pezeshkian: 'end war from position of strength' + admits economic crisis
IRGC: backs state broadcaster, threatens neighbors re economic measures
Khamenei/Mojtaba: orders factions to stop fighting, urges less dollar reliance
game_theory.uncertainty: No real-time intelligence on back-channel talks; news is evidence not ground truth. Decision signals pending extraction.
